name: smwgraphics-wacky-roofs
title: Wacky Roofs
description:
Taken from scrapped hack Dinomar.
What you need to know is that this comes with a readme, three graphics files, two map16 files and a sample level with wacky surprises. Two of the graphics files are Sprite GFX. For FG graphics, it uses palette 2 and 3.

Have fun.
